input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: Section 17(b) does give us a convenience termination right and Garman has no convenience right (Garman may terminate only on insolvency events or uncured material default under 17(c)), so the vendor-side limb is compliant. However, the customer limb sits only at our fallback: notice is ninety days rather than thirty, and there is no refund of prepaid fees on a convenience termination (the refund in 17(c)/p0128 applies only where we terminate for Garman's default, and Section 8's full refund applies only on rejection during acceptance). Under a perpetual, fee-based term (17(a)) with prepaid maintenance fees, we should be able to exit on 30 days' notice and recover unused prepaid amounts.

proposal.summary: Shorten Sparkling's convenience termination notice to 30 days and add pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened our convenience-termination notice from ninety to thirty days and added a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for the period after termination, consistent with our position that we can exit on 30 days' notice without penalty. If Garman needs longer wind-down, we can live with a 60-day notice period provided the refund of unused prepaid fees remains.

ops.oldText: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
ops.newText: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time, in whole or in part, for convenience and without penalty or early termination charge, upon thirty (30) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the thirty (30) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes, and Garman shall refund to Sparkling, within thirty (30) calendar days of the effective date of termination, all prepaid fees (including prepaid maintenance and support fees) for the period after the effective date of termination.
